title: Sources
description: Contents of sources.json: the bibliography that data records cite by id. Also rendered as the in-app source list (S5.2).

id.description: Stable identifier in kebab-case, e.g. teachme-foot.

label.description: Short label shown next to a claim, e.g. "Snow ym. 1995".

citation.description: Full citation: authors, title, edition or journal, year, and section or page where relevant.

url.description: Link to the source, if one exists.
